svg.title: GPT-6 Astra: effort evidence
svg.desc: Four panels: AA Intelligence v4.3.2, weighted tokens/task, derived decode seconds/task, API cost/task. Effort categories are ordinal per model. Missing data is not zero and is not interpolated.

g.text: AA suite proxies. Decode time excludes first-token delay and overhead. API cost and tokens are not subscription quota.
Each effort is categorical within this model; identical names across models do not imply equal work. Gaps break lines.
Weighted output tokens per suite task
Derived weighted decode seconds/task — NOT wall-clock task latency
Weighted API USD/task — NOT Max/Codex quota charges
Input/task, subscription quota, lead wall time, failure/rework remain unmeasured. Source suite totals are not divided.
